en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a riverside view of historic buildings in Grimma, Germany. The buildings include a large, ornate structure with tall windows and a pointed tower or spire, likely a castle or school, and are reflected in the calm river in the foreground. Tree branches frame the top part of the image. There is German text printed in red along the bottom.
